note: Fixtures that point at real Phase 4 evidence in place, rather than at a copy of it.
A copy would be 6.3 MB of duplicated journal and could drift from the thing it claims
to be. Evidence in this project is immutable, so the committed tree is a stable target,
and grading the actual recorded bytes is strictly stronger than grading a snapshot.
The expectation is supplied HERE and not written into qualification/phase4/, because that
tree is an earlier phase's evidence and no commit may add to it. The runs themselves are
genuinely undeclared, which is why 'undeclaredVariant' exists below: the same run graded
without an expectation, to show what an undeclared run costs.
